reviews.title: Works great…description wrong
reviews.comment: Graphic card works as expected.  Description says 3 HDMI and 1 HDMI 2.1 ports.  This is reversed there are 3 HDMI 2.1 ports and only one HDMI port. Had to buy an adapter for my second monitor to work.
reviews.author: Heather

reviews.title: False Advertising (faulty)
reviews.comment:
Arrived faulty. Called MSI and they said that it was sold to NewEgg 5 years ago with a three year warranty, resold to Amazon, and then sold to me. Short circuited before the PC was even fully built.
False advertising.
reviews.author: Brynna Cox
